newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums hold firm against voaltile gas oi.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums hold firm against voaltile gas oi.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums to gas oil futures remained firm on Monday but the volatile gas oil futures market kept buyers scarce, traders said.
Benchmark Feb IPE gas oil added a further $4.50 a tonne to Friday's near seven dollar drop. The market swept through the key $200 level.
Jet barges were assessed around Feb +$29/30 fob ARA but the market remained very quiet with little buying from refiners.
Traders there was still some interest for fob cargoes in northern Europe which had continued to underpin premiums despite slack trade.
Cargoes were assessed at Feb IPE +$27 fob ARA and high freight costs kept cif barrels notionally $8-9 a tonne higher.
